name: Arenales de San Gregorio (Spain)
description: White field with a purple stripe along the lower edge, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Arenales de San Gregorio (a tree, a crescent and a book on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Arenales de San Gregorio; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Arenales de San Gregorio arms — tree, crescent and book on blue
